title: The Judgment on the Twenty-Five Men in Jerusalem
description: Ezekiel is taken in a vision to the east gate of the house of the Lord, where twenty-five men, including Jaazaniah and Pelatiah, are plotting injustice and saying that the city is the pot and they are the meat. The Lord commands Ezekiel to prophesy against them: they will be led out of the city, judged at the border of Israel, and fall by the sword. While Ezekiel is prophesying, Pelatiah dies, and the prophet throws himself down and cries out to the Lord for the rest of Israel.
